title: Cash Pickup Reactivation: Days for Name Corrections Already Recorded
content:
**Training note.** When an expired Cash Pickup pickup is reactivated, the name corrections already recorded on the transfer add days to the reactivated window.

**How are the corrections counted?** Every recipient-name correction recorded on the transfer counts, whenever it was made.

**How many days?**

| Name corrections already recorded on the transfer | Days added to the reactivated window |
|---|---|
| two or more | 2 |
| exactly one | 1 |
| none | none |

The days are whole calendar days and move the reactivated pickup's last day of collection later.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- A transfer whose recipient name was corrected once: 1 day.
- A transfer corrected three times: 2 days, the top band being two or more.
- A transfer never corrected: no days.
